name: Lost Valley Redoubt
summary: Lost Valley Redoubt is a Nordic ruin found in the Reach, located southeast of Gloomreach. The Dark Descent, an ancient ritual site, is located deep below, which the ruins were built over.
notes: The Red Eagle's Flight achievement is unlocked at the same location as Bard's Leap Summit from Skyrim.
Lost Valley Redoubt also appeared in Skyrim.
Draugr can be seen in many open sarcophagi in the barrow, but none of them will come alive.
